600098.SS.longBusinessSummary: Guangzhou Development Group Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy business in China and internationally. It is involved in the development, investment, construction, and operation management of energy projects; new energy power generation, energy storage, and electricity sale and services; and upstream gas source investment and procurement, midstream transportation and receiving, and downstream distribution and sales, as well as urban gas pipeline construction. The company also engages in the investment and operation of coal, oil, ports, shipping, and hazardous chemical storage, as well as leasing oil tanks and supporting facilities; and provision of energy finance services. In addition, it is involved in asset management; aerated concrete; management services; photovoltaic and wind power electricity generation; sewage treatment; port loading and unloading; warehousing; gas meter production; sale of coal; agricultural product sale; coastal cargo transportation; and electricity, heat, gas, and water production and supply. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Guangzhou, China. Guangzhou Development Group Incorporated operates as a subsidiary of Guangzhou Industrial Investment Holdings Group.

It also provides arrayed waveguide grating and filter; chips; devices; modules; and laser chips, data center interconnection subsystems, and other products used in backbone networks, metropolitan area networks, access networks, data networks, radio and television networks, and other fields. In addition, the company offers 5G active antenna, ICS mobile companion, elevator-type micro active distribution, and extended-type micro active distribution; single-band digital repeater, dual-band digital repeater, single-band digital active DAS System, dual-band digital active DAS system, and triple-band digital active DAS system; and 4G/5G small cell solution. Additionally, the company is involved in overseas project contracting and construction, industrial investment and broadband access and supporting engineering, automotive wiring harness manufacturing, software development, and other businesses. Jiangsu Etern Company Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Suzhou, China.

600141.SS.longBusinessSummary: Hubei Xingfa Chemicals Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, produces, and sells phosphorus-based chemicals in China and internationally.
